summary: Fun memory game for kids. Explore, spot ghosts and build focus skills
description:
SEARCH, REMEMBER AND MATCH THE GHOSTS!
Pango Memory is a big memory game designed for children ages 3 to 5. A mysterious mansion, filled with playful ghosts, becomes their playground.
In each game, your child explores the rooms, discovers new hiding places, and remembers their location. By matching the pairs of ghosts, they move forward step by step… until the final reward!

TRUSTED BRAND, REFERENCE GAME
With more than 20 educational apps and 20 million downloads worldwide, Pango is a trusted choice for families. Pango Memory follows this tradition: a simple, smart, and reassuring game designed to develop memory and logic from the age of 3.

A RICH AND STIMULATING CONTENT
• Explore 11 mysterious rooms in a mansion full of surprises.
• Hunt for the ghosts, memorize their hiding spots, and match the pairs.
• Find Pango’s friends who are hiding all around the mansion.

Each game sparks curiosity, trains memory, and encourages attention and problem-solving. Designed for preschool and kindergarten children, Pango Halloween provides a positive and rewarding learning environment.

TRY FOR FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE WHOLE MANSION
Pango Memory is free to download, with the first game included.
Additional rooms in the mansion can be unlocked through in-app purchases, one by one or as a complete pack, depending on your preference.
All purchases are protected by parental controls. And as always with Pango: no ads.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO HALLOWEEN
• Easy to pick up, designed for little hands.
• Perfect for travel, quiet moments, or short play sessions.
• 100% ad-free and no hidden purchases, with built-in parental control.
• Complies with COPPA and GDPR standards for safe and independent use.

THE VALUES OF PANGO
For over 15 years, we have been creating games that put children at the center. Games that respect their pace, stimulate their curiosity, and develop their logic… without stress, without ads, without pressure. Because a good game is above all one that helps them grow!
